text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Will the 
victor be Hishi Amazon, or Narita Brian? 
The other Umamusume are formidable foes
as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a deep breath,
Hishi Amazon focused 
her mind. Her long-awaited showdown with 
Narita Brian was about to begin—!
